desc: Ideation complete: decompose the answer into C(N-2, k-2) times the total pairwise Manhattan distance over all unordered cell pairs.
Confirm the combinatorial factor C(N-2, k-2) for choosing the remaining k-2 cells after fixing an unordered pair of occupied cells.
Implement complete Solution.distanceSum with modular nCr and closed-form row/column distance sums.
Validate implementation against examples and edge cases such as k = 2, k = N, one-dimensional grids, and N = 2.
